string.name: name
string.value: Renegades Gift Box

string.name: desc
string.value: A gift box celebrating the arrival of Renegades. The box can be opened on June 30, 2012 and it will disappear if you don’t open the box on that day.

string.name: name
string.value: Phantom Gift Box

string.name: desc
string.value: A gift box celebrating the arrival of Phantom. The box can be opened on July 14, 2012 and it will disappear if you don’t open the box on that day.

string.name: name
string.value: Unidentified Love Letter

string.name: desc
string.value: A letter sent to you by an anonymous admirer. You can feel how much love was put into it...maybe you should open it...

string.name: name
string.value: Super Carved Slot Miracle Cube

string.name: desc
string.value: This fragment broke away from the Super Carved Slot Miracle Cube. Double-click to trade for useful items.

string.name: name
string.value: Tempest Coin Pouch

string.name: desc
string.value: A coin pouch in honor of Tempest. Open it to obtain Tempest Coins. If you are lucky, you can possibly obtain other treasures. It can only be opened until 2/12/13 when the event ends.

string.name: name
string.value: Tempest Commemorative Box

string.name: desc
string.value: A box in honor of Tempest. Open it to obtain great goods. However, it can only be opened until 2/12/13 when the event ends.

string.name: name
string.value: Tempest Transform Potion

string.name: desc
string.value: A Transform Potion made by an Alchemist in honor of Tempest. Not even he knows what you'll turn into! However, it can only be used until TKTKTK when the event ends.

string.name: name
string.value: Kaiser Epic Set

string.name: desc
string.value: A box that contains the previous Kaiser's helmet, armor, and shoes.

string.name: name
string.value: Kaiser Advanced Epic Set

string.name: desc
string.value: A box that contains the previous Kaiser's helmet, armor, shoes, and Tempest Claymore.

string.name: name
string.value: Kaiser Superior Epic Set

string.name: desc
string.value: A box that contains the previous Kaiser's helmet, armor, shoes, Tempest Claymore, and special title.
